territories.name: Amazon
territories.subtitle: Northern Bolivia · Beni & Pando · Climate-resilient landscapes
territories.bio: Humid tropical forests with globally significant biodiversity. Home to Tacana, Ese Ejja and other Indigenous communities. Focus on Brazil nut, açaí, cacao and community forestry.

territories.name: Yungas
territories.subtitle: La Paz & Cochabamba · Mountain forests and coffee
territories.bio: Cloud forests between 1,200–2,200 m where shade-grown coffee, cacao and honey link conservation and livelihoods. Strong cooperative tradition.

territories.name: Chiquitania
territories.subtitle: Santa Cruz · Dry forests and beekeeping
territories.bio: Tropical dry forest and Chiquitano communities. Beekeeping, timber and non-timber products with a strong focus on fire management and restoration.
